meaning:
1) blemish, spot, defect
1a) of physical defect
1b) of moral stain

renderings.kjv: he be that hath a blemish
And if there be any blemish

elsewhere.note: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
“This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and…
If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.
Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect…
Surely then you will lift up your face without spot; Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear:
One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
